title: App frame with flex only
summary: A column of header, body and footer, with a row of sidebar, content and aside in the middle.
explanation: The page is a flex column at least 360px tall. The header and footer use flex-shrink: 0 so they keep their height, and the middle section takes the rest with flex: 1.

Inside the middle row, the sidebar and aside are flex: 0 0 120px, which fixes their width. The content uses flex: 1 and min-width: 0, so long content can shrink instead of forcing the row wider than the frame.
tryThis: Remove min-width: 0 from .content and add a long word to it: the row overflows the frame.
Change the sidebar to flex: 1 0 120px: it now grows along with the content.
Remove flex: 1 from .middle: the body shrinks to its content and leaves an empty gap above the footer.

children.text: Content grows to fill the middle row and wraps as needed.
